source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1930, p. 9 ("Ulster local elections: the contests in Fermanagh and Tyrone")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: votes read on the block image of the Belfast News-Letter results of 6 June 1930 and checked against the Ulster Herald and Strabane Chronicle

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Lislea (Plumbridge) was the only contest in the district; the other divisions were returned unopposed and are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The unopposed returns in the other divisions (and Tullyard, where the retiring member was deemed elected) are added from the Ulster Herald's nominations list of 26 April 1930, p. 5 (6 Nov 2026). Dunn (outgoing member) 155; Smith 55; majority 100. Both candidates were Unionists.
